title: Grateful Dead Live at Roosevelt Stadium on 1973-08-01
source: matrix of shnid 121129 (source 1) and shnid 92478 (source 2) Monte Barry on Dec 16, 2012

ai_review.summary: Mixed feelings about the matrix recording, but reviewers agree it captures a great show.
ai_review.review: Both fans rave about the performance, calling it a great show, while opinions on the matrix source diverge—one reviewer finds this MTX less appealing than a soundboard version, another loves the matrix mix. Overall the concert shines despite the split view on recording quality.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong positive comments on the musical performance outweigh mixed opinions on the matrix sound, leading to a solid above‑average rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: One reviewer finds this MTX less favorable compared to a soundboard version, while another praises the matrix mix; overall sound is acceptable but not outstanding.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers describe the concert as a great performance overall, though no specific set‑list details are mentioned.
